about: Ten jobs AI can do for you now, one per card. A full-bleed cover scene, then for each job: the tools that do it as real logos, the job in Anton capitals, a real screenshot of it being done in a mint frame, one prompt to try and three numbered steps. Sources, dates and image credits go in the post description.
